description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing localisation locations within the Opencart admin interface. It includes methods for displaying, listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting location records, along with generating related UI components and handling user permissions.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Controller class for handling CRUD operations and views related to localisation locations in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main location management page with header, footer, and location list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch and display the list of locations.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of locations, including pagination links and data, and returns the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a location, pre-populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to add or update a location, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected location records, with permission validation.
